title: Restore trust when implementation evidence moves or changes
statement: As a change author, I can diagnose and repair stale or overbroad implementation evidence, so that readers can trust the code linked from each explanation.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A code link follows unchanged referenced lines when they move.
A code link is marked stale when its referenced content changes.
A stale code link shows what changed since it was captured.
The mapping view identifies evidence that is broad or weakly justified.
Replacing one evidence record either completes fully or leaves the original unchanged.
An author can refresh evidence to the landed source revision after merge.
Changing only documentation does not make unchanged implementation evidence stale.
